description: IMPL-032: the `default` pack ships no mapping module, and now says so instead of answering with a missing-parameter error. A jurisdiction-free chart of accounts has no lawful statement layout it could ship — a balance sheet gliederung is always somebody's law — so silence is the correct answer and not a gap. What was wrong is how it arrived: `balanceSheet requires the parameter "mapping"` reads as *you forgot something*, and a caller who then passes one gets `mapping "x" is not loaded`, which reads as *you named the wrong one*. Neither says *this pack cannot do this and here is what to do about it*. The refusal now carries `available`, empty for this pack, and the message names `importMapping`. Same shape as `tenantConfiguration.mappings`, which answers the same question without an error at all — that is the route an application should take, and this fixture pins that the two agree.

projections.comment: The route without an error: the tenant reports that it has no mappings at all.
projections.name: tenantConfiguration

projections.comment: And the refusal says the same thing in the same words.
projections.name: balanceSheet
